items.title: How much does 1:1 frequency affect how many chances a concern has to surface?
items.description: L3's report-led 1:1 works from the very first meeting once the structure is right — it doesn't require repeated meetings to start working. But each 1:1 is still the only protected moment for a report-led opening to happen at all. Drag the cadence slider to see how many of those protected openings actually occur within a typical quarter (90 days) as meetings get spaced further apart.
items.compute: const openingsPerQuarter = Math.floor(90 / params.cadenceDays); return { openingsPerQuarter };
